ALTER PROC [DW].[HIST_SP_DW_FACTSECURITYPORTFOLIO] AS
BEGIN


WITH Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
    SELECT BCASP.CustomerAccountId, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio  BCASP
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCASP.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountID and DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    GROUP BY BCASP.CustomerAccountId
)
,Balance AS (
SELECT 
convert(varchar,BCASP.[DATESTAMP],112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BRANCHSK AS BranchSK
,DDBANK.BANKSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSk
,DDA.AccountID AS AccountID
,SUM(BCASP.EndValue) AS PortfolioEndValueFull
,SUM(BCASP.EndValue)/ DCA.CNT AS PortfolioEndValueProrated
,BCASP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio BCASP
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNT BCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCASP.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBRANCH DDB ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDB.BRANCHID
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DDBANK ON BCASP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBANK.BankId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCASP.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = DDA.ACCOUNTID 
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DCA.CustomerAccountId = BCASP.CustomerAccountId
GROUP BY 
 convert(varchar,BCASP.[DATESTAMP],112)
,DDB.BRANCHSK
,DDBANK.BANKSK
,DDA.AccountSK
,DDA.AccountID
,BCASP.SourceSystemCode
,DCA.CNT
)
,GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK,
	BankSK,
	AccountSK,
    AccountId,
	SourceSystemCode, 
    CONVERT(DATE, MIN(BusinessDateSK)) as min_date, 
    CONVERT(DATE, MAX(BusinessDateSK)) max_date 
  FROM 
    Balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL) AND BusinessDateSK >= '2023-01-01'
    GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	b.BranchSK,
    b.BankSK,
    b.AccountSK,
    b.AccountID,
	b.SourceSystemCode,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,FullDate,112) AS FullDate2,
    a.FullDate, 
    b.min_date, 
    b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
  WHERE 
    (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,Distinct_Balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, PortfolioEndValueFull, PortfolioEndValueProrated, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm
FROM Balance b
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactSecurityPortfolio
(
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSk
,AccountID
,PortfolioEndValueFull
,PortfolioEndValueProrated
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT 
ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate) AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,MAX(PortfolioEndValueFull) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode
ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode) AS PortfolioEndValueFull
,MAX(PortfolioEndValueProrated) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode
ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode) AS PortfolioEndValueProrated
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN Distinct_Balance b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

END
GO
